title: EA buyout debt draws $25 billion in orders as banks navigate volatile markets
title_zh: 银行应对动荡的市场，EA 收购债务吸引了 250 亿美元的订单
summary: Investing.com -- Investor demand for Electronic Arts Inc (NASDAQ:EA) nearly $15 billion debt offering has reached approximately $25 billion, a sign of resilient appetite for large-scale buyouts even as Wall Street banks struggle with a "white-knuckle" credit environment.
summary_zh: Investing.com——投资者对艺电公司（Electronic Arts Inc，纳斯达克股票代码：EA）近150亿美元债券发行的需求已达到约250亿美元，这表明即使华尔街银行在“紧张”的信贷环境中挣扎，人们对大规模收购的兴趣依然强劲。

title: Amazon’s Rivr Deal And AI Phone Plans Shape Long Term Outlook
title_zh: 亚马逊的 Rivr 交易和人工智能手机计划塑造长期前景
summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS: AMZN) has acquired Zurich based robotics startup Rivr, which focuses on autonomous stair climbing delivery robots, to accelerate doorstep delivery automation.
summary_zh: 亚马逊（NasdaqGS：AMZN）收购了总部位于苏黎世的机器人初创公司 Rivr，该公司专注于自动爬楼梯送货机器人，以加速送货上门自动化。

title: Nvidia Strikes Massive AI Deal With Amazon -- $1 Trillion Opportunity Looms By 2027
title_zh: Nvidia 与亚马逊达成大规模 AI 协议——到 2027 年将带来 1 万亿美元的机遇
summary: Nvidia will supply over 1 million GPUs and related chips to Amazon through 2027, targeting AI cloud workloads and inference
summary_zh: 到 2027 年，Nvidia 将向亚马逊供应超过 100 万个 GPU 和相关芯片，目标是人工智能云工作负载和推理
